findings.title: Adding the first series does not apply the pending range
findings.description: Adding a series only mutates `seriesCountRef`; it does not change any effect dependency. Consequently, populating an already-ready chart leaves the Context’s current range unapplied until the range changes again. The translation test masks this by calling `setRange` immediately after `addSeries`. Make data availability reactive or explicitly apply the pending range when data becomes available, and test adding data without changing Context.

findings.title: Series count does not establish that chart data exists
findings.description: Every successful `addSeries` increments the counter, including valid configurations with `data: []`. Likewise, `updateSeries` can clear all data without updating the counter. The range effect therefore passes its guard even when the time scale remains empty—the condition it explicitly intends to prevent. Track populated data rather than allocated series, including updates and removals, and cover empty-series and cleared-data cases.
